text:
Maya (PM): heads-up — large enterprise just flagged they need a private on-prem proof-of-concept by mid-q2. asking if we can realistically hit a pilot timeline and what cross-team blockers look like
Ash (Eng): mid-q2 is tight. main blocker is runtime work for kv-prefetch + prefix caching for long contexts. rough ETA 4-5w dev + 2w testing if we deprioritize streaming for pilot
Liam (Runtime): +1 to Ash. also need to validate quantized model path for their HW — otherwise perf will be 2x worse. can do compatibility shims but that’s another 1-2w
Nisha (Infra): provisioning GPUs for a private cluster is doable but needs signed capacity commit. lead time ~3w for infra/provisioning + network config (VPC peering / IP allowlist)
Kai (Security): must include KMS/HSM integration and audit logging. if customer requires FIPS/HSM we add an approval path — add 2-3w for security review and certs. also need to run an attestation checklist
Maya (PM): ok so rough total is dev 5w + compat 2w + infra 3w + sec 3w = ~13w; we need to compress. can we define a pilot minimal scope?
Ash (Eng): propose MVP scope: - private API (no streaming) - pinned model version - telemetry + basic cost controls - no tool-calls, no realtime reranking
Liam (Runtime): that MVP removes streaming and tool calling, saves ~2w. quantization shim could be deferred if customer accepts higher perf cost for pilot
Nisha (Infra): we can parallelize provisioning with runtime dev if we start now. need commitment from sales/legal for SOC/NDA to start network work
Kai (Security): can start security scoping in parallel. but gating: KMS keys provisioned and I64 attestation before pilot launch
Maya (PM): action list: 1) Ash & Liam: break down runtime tasks into 2-week sprints and call out blocking PRs 2) Nisha: provisioning SOW + network checklist 3) Kai: security gating checklist 4) Sales: push signed commitment
Ash (Eng): I'll post a short tech plan by EOD with estimated PRs and a risky-areas section
Liam (Runtime): I'll spike quantization shim this week and report perf delta by Fri
Nisha (Infra): starting network docs now. tagging @sales for the commitment step :point_down:
Kai (Security): I'll draft the security gating doc and required evidence fields. quick question — do we need third-party pen test before pilot or after?
Maya (PM): for pilot, can we defer full pen test to post-pilot if we keep pilot to <5 users and isolated cluster? need @kai confirmation
Kai (Security): OK to defer full pentest if pilot strictly limited and we disable external integrations. must document scope and get exceptions approved (CISO)
deploy-bot: deploy check — private-deploy/pilot: no blockers found for infra config, but certs missing: KMS integration pending
Ash (Eng): if certs are pending, can we do an internal canary on our infra instead of customer infra? reduces risk while KMS gets provisioned
Maya (PM): good idea. plan B = internal canary on dedicated pool. customer still sees private API surface but behind our staging network
Nisha (Infra): I'll reserve a small dedicated pool for a canary. need a ticket from Ash so I can link configs
Ash (Eng): creating ticket now: infra-ticket-6421 — will cc runtime + infra + security
Maya (PM): tentative launch criteria for pilot (feel free to edit):
``
- Private API endpoint reachable from customer network
- Model pinned and passes smoke quality tests
- Latency < 500ms p50 on pilot traffic
- Audit logs flowing to KMS/S3 and accessible to security
- Fallback to hosted-dedicated when capacity breached
- Signed commitment and NDA in place
```
Liam (Runtime): suggest adding a quality guard: a small eval suite of 50 prompts to check regressions vs hosted baseline
Kai (Security): adding: evidence of key rotation policy and logging retention config
Maya (PM): excellent. I'll put this in a short PRD and share with partners. can everyone ACK by EOD so we can book resources? :pray:
Ash (Eng): ACK :thumbsup:
Liam (Runtime): ACK :thumbsup:
Nisha (Infra): ACK :thumbsup:
Kai (Security): ACK with security caveat noted :white_check_mark:
Maya (PM): thanks — will loop in sales/legal and set weekly 15m syncs. moving to action items now.
